title: Razorpay webhook envelope (shared base)
description: Source: core/billing/.../gateway/RazorpayGatewayClient.java#parseWebhookEvent + #extractSubscriptionId, read directly (2026-07-19). Not a $ref target Razorpay itself publishes - this is the shape the CURRENT parser actually reads (json.optString('event',''), then payload.subscription.entity.id) via org.json's lenient opt*() accessors, which never throw on a missing field, they just return the fallback. Per-event schemas in this directory extend this one with allOf + an 'event' const. Real Razorpay payloads carry more top-level fields (account_id, contains[], created_at) not read by the parser today and therefore not required here.

id.description: extractSubscriptionId reads payload.subscription.entity.id via optString("id", null) - a missing id is tolerated by the parser (returns null), but every real fixture in this corpus supplies one so the replay/schema tests exercise the populated case.
